ja384:1.1: Dhammaṃ caratha ñātayo, dhammaṃ caratha, bhaddaṃ vo, dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti asmiṃ loke paramhi cā 'ti.
ja384:2.1: Bhaddako vat' ayaṃ pakkhī dijo paramadhammiko, ekapādena tiṭṭhanto dhammam evānusāsatīti.
ja384:3.1: Nāssa sīlaṃ vijānātha, anaññāya pasaṃsatha, bhutvā aṇḍañ ca potañ ca dhammo dhammo ti bhāsati.
ja384:4.1: Aññaṃ bhaṇati vācāya, aññaṃ kāyena kubbati, vācāya no ca kāyena na taṃ dhammaṃ adhiṭṭhito.
ja384:5.1: Vācāya sakhilo manoviduggo paṭicchanno kūpasayo kaṇhasappo dhammadhajo gāmanigamasādhu bhaddako dujjāno purisena bālisena.
ja384:6.1: Imaṃ tuṇḍehi pakkhehi pādā c' imaṃ vipothatha, chavaṃ h' imaṃ vināsetha, nāyaṃ saṃvāsanāraho ti.
